title_sq: SHES TOKE TRUALL ME LEJE NDERTIMI BANESE 1 KATESHE-BERZHITE!
description_sq:
Ne zonen e Berzhites shesim toke truall me leje ndertimi per objekt nje katesh.
Vendndodhja eshte ne nje zone te banuar me hyrje dalje te lehte. Infrastuktura e tokes eshte e rregullt, disponon pus me cilesi uji te mire. Eshte betonuar njolla e objektit dhe eshte bere nivelimi i tokes. Siperfaqa e tokës eshte 1450m nga të cilat 200m janë truall. Objekti ka kollona te cilat te japin mundesine per tu ngritur deri ne tre kate. Prona eshte e rrethuar me mure dekorativ nga tre anet dhe disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
 Per me shume informacione apo vizite ne prone ju lutem me konaktoni.
title_en: LAND FOR SALE PLOT WITH BUILDING PERMIT 1 STORY HOUSE-BERZHITE!
description_en: In the area of ​​Berzhita, we sell land with a building permit for a one-story building. The location is in a residential area with easy access. The infrastructure of the land is regular, it has a well with good water quality. The area of ​​the building has been concreted and the ground has been leveled. The surface of the land is 1450m, of which 200m are land. The building has columns that allow it to rise up to three floors. The property is surrounded by decorative walls on three sides and has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, please contact me.
